name: Editorial Magazine × Electronic Ink
tagline: A Monocle-style editorial deck: serif headlines, warm e-ink themes and a WebGL fluid background.
description: A horizontal-swipe deck system that reads like a printed magazine with a little code stitched in. Large serif headlines (Playfair Display with Noto Serif SC), a sans-serif body, monospace metadata and hairline rules carry the hierarchy instead of shadows or floating cards. A WebGL fluid background shows through on hero pages only, and light and dark pages alternate to set the rhythm. Five electronic-ink themes are built in and chosen with one data-theme attribute. Presenter mode, speaker notes, an audience window, overview and a low-power static mode are part of the template. Style A of the Guizang PPT Skill, written for narrative talks, opinion pieces and personal voice.

palette.description: Five electronic-ink themes, one per deck: ink-classic (default), indigo-porcelain, forest-ink, kraft-paper and dune. Each pairs a warm paper tone with a deep ink color; every text, rule and accent color comes from theme variables, never from hand-written hex values

typography.cn: Noto Serif SC (headlines), Noto Sans SC (body)
typography.style: Serif headlines, sans-serif body, monospace metadata labels; the hierarchy comes from type size and typeface contrast, not from shadows or cards

best_for: Narrative talks, industry observations, salons, product launches with a story, opinion pieces and anything with a strong personal voice, in English or Chinese. Works best with a few large ideas per slide, photographs and short data callouts.
avoid_for: Dense tables, training courseware (information density is too low) and decks that several people edit together. The WebGL background needs a reasonably modern machine; a static mode is built in.
navigation: Horizontal swipe: arrow keys, mouse wheel, touch swipe and bottom dots; Esc opens the overview, P presenter mode, B static mode
